62.DSCR:
A mercenary belonging to $$アッセンブルＥＸ－１０$$.
Originally an officer in the regular army of the $$クメン$$ Kingdom and a member of the royal guard.
He had been on friendly terms with $$カンジェルマン$$ as well, but, angered that $$カンジェルマン$$ had split the nation, he bolted from the lukewarm regular army to become a mercenary in order to overthrow him.
Serious-minded, he often ends up as the one who holds the unit together.
In the decisive battle of the $$クメン$$ Civil War, he charged into the base in order to strike down $$カンジェルマン$$ personally. Learning $$カンジェルマン$$'s aim from $$モニカ#votoms$$, a childhood friend who was facing death, he angrily challenged $$カンジェルマン$$ to a balancing contest.
Though he succeeded in striking down $$カンジェルマン$$, on learning $$カンジェルマン$$'s true intentions, he wept at $$カンジェルマン$$'s death in the end.

68.DSCR:
The daughter of $$桂$$ and $$ティナ$$, born on February 20 of Year 2 of the $$混乱時空世紀$$. 18 years old.
At age 11 she enlisted in the $$チラム$$ army as a child soldier and worked as a soldier. She met $$オルソン$$ when he was placed under the protection of her grandfather $$マイケル#orguss$$, and saw in him the ideal image of a father.
When her mother and grandfather were then killed in an attack by $$ムウ#orguss$$, she resolved to fight not for revenge but to keep anyone else from experiencing the same grief she had. She volunteered for a transfer to the front lines, and $$オルソン$$ drilled combat techniques into her. As a result, the delicacy that women possess was joined by the bloodline of a genius pilot, and a first-class woman warrior was born.
Toward her father, whose face she does not even know, she holds loneliness that he is not by her side, and hatred over the hardship placed on her grandfather and mother. Even when $$オルソン$$ later told her that the $$特異点|lc$$ $$チラム$$ was after was in fact her real father, she kept stubbornly denying it out of the resentment she had carried for many years. When she heard, moreover, that $$桂$$ had had a child with $$ミムジィ$$, her irritation only grew.
But when the order later came to protect the $$特異点|lc$$, she suppressed her own feelings and carried out the mission faithfully. In the meantime, the awkward father and daughter clashed repeatedly, each time making $$オルソン$$ sigh. But when she was wounded, there was $$桂$$ at her bedside, nursing her devotedly. That incident seems to have dissolved the bad feelings between them, and when she sortied again, she wore $$エマーン$$ clothing instead of a $$チラム$$ military uniform.
Just before $$桂$$ entered the $$大特異点$$, she finally called $$桂$$ 'Father' and handed him a pendant with a photo of $$ティナ$$ in it. At the same time, she was entrusted by $$オルソン$$ with his sunglasses as a keepsake.

69.DSCR:
An $$エマーン$$ girl born in the $$混乱時空世紀$$. 17 years old.
She comes from the $$ラース家$$, a distinguished family in $$エマーン$$, and is also its heir.
While gaining caravan experience as a member of the $$ファクトリー$$, she met $$桂$$. Her betrothed, $$スレイ$$, was already in the $$ファクトリー$$, but she was drawn to the forward $$桂$$, and her heart wavered.
Just as her reproductive period was about to end, partly out of impatience, she faced her own heart honestly and once promised to marry $$スレイ$$. But right after that, an attack came from the pursuit unit of $$マニーシャ$$, who was trying to seize $$桂$$, and $$スレイ$$, who had sortied for $$ミムジィ$$'s sake, died.
For a time she was steeped in deep grief, but she eventually recovered and grew close to $$桂$$, and in the end even became pregnant with $$桂$$'s child.

70.DSCR:
An $$エマーン$$ woman who serves as chief of the $$ファクトリー$$.
Scholarly and thoughtful, but sheltered from the world and set in her own pace.
$$エマーン$$ women have a reproductive period, and once it passes they lose reproductive function. However, since the body hardly changes after that, she still keeps a youthful appearance despite already being just short of 30 years old.
Also, once the reproductive period passes, $$エマーン$$ people lose their sexual shame, so they no longer mind exposing their naked bodies. She would casually walk into the bath while $$桂$$ was using it, for example.
Though from the distinguished $$トーブ家$$, she left politics to her twin sister and carried on a carefree caravan life, and it was then that she came across $$桂$$. Learning that $$桂$$ was the $$特異点|lc$$ for repairing the $$混乱時空$$, she decided to protect him. This choice set her at odds not only with $$チラム$$ but even with her own sister $$マニーシャ$$, which pained her.
However, she succeeded in reconciling with her sister, and formed an alliance with $$チラム$$ as well for the shared goal of repairing space-time.
Among the infinite possibilities that appeared after $$桂$$ and the others entered the $$大特異点$$ was a scene of her nestled beside her lover $$ランチ$$, who had once stepped aside for her sister's sake.

71.DSCR:
A kind of Earthling from a parallel universe, with the appearance of a dinosaur.
He is searching for a lover from whom he was separated when they were both caught up in a space-time displacement.
With a burner built into his mouth, he often breathed fire to drive off the $$モズク族$$ who kept attacking, and on peddling trips conversely helped draw in customers. Also, when $$グローマ$$'s trade goods ran out, he once found a grape grove with his keen sense of smell, and was useful in many ways.
He is also the one who named $$オーガス$$.
He remembers the sensation of the space-time displacement experienced in the past, and can sense its precursor through the reaction of his tail, so there were times when $$グローマ$$ escaped trouble.
As the journey continued, his long-held wish was granted and he found his homeland. But it had become a ruin where not only the lover he had been searching for but even his own companions had all died out. Despairing at the sheer devastation, he finally wished to stay behind alone and die. But after being persuaded by $$桂$$, he changed his mind and returned to $$グローマ$$, which had by now become a second home.

78.DSCR:
A central figure of the $$エゥーゴ$$. His rank is Lieutenant Colonel.
He was the first captain of the $$アーガマ$$, but when $$ブライト$$ joined the $$エゥーゴ$$ he gave up that seat and became captain of the $$ラーディッシュ$$.
A good man overflowing with human warmth, he was also deeply trusted by the crew.
He had fought in the $$一年戦争$$ as well, and on the battlefield once felt the 'pressure' of the $$赤い彗星$$.
He had feelings for $$エマ$$ and often showed an innocent side.
In the final battle with the $$ティターンズ$$, to protect $$エマ$$'s $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$, which had fallen into dire straits, he used the $$ラーディッシュ$$ as a shield and met his fate together with the exploding ship.

80.DSCR:
The child left behind by $$ドズル・ザビ$$, a lieutenant general of the former Principality of $$ジオン$$ military. 8 years old.
Though still so young, she has been made a symbol of the revival of $$ジオン$$ by her guardian $$ハマーン$$. But that is nothing more than authority as $$ハマーン$$'s puppet, and for that reason she has received a considerably biased education.

81.DSCR:
A core member of $$カラバ$$, the $$エゥーゴ$$'s support organization, and captain of the $$アウドムラ$$.
He had been the curator of a war museum in $$ケネディ$$, but stood up after witnessing the tyranny of the $$ティターンズ$$.
During the $$一年戦争$$ he was a crew member of the $$ホワイトベース$$, and after the war ended he married $$フラウ$$ and adopted the orphans $$カツ$$, $$レツ$$ and $$キッカ#zeta$$ as his children.

82.DSCR:
A $$ニュータイプ$$ pilot belonging to the Earth Federation Forces' $$ロンド・ベル$$ unit. His rank is Captain.
In the $$一年戦争$$, he rode the $$ＲＸ－７８ガンダム$$ into numerous battles, growing as a $$ニュータイプ$$ and leaving behind a legendary combat record.
But after the war, the Earth Federation viewed his abilities with suspicion, and forced him to live under virtual house arrest. Even so, during the $$グリプス戦役$$ he joined $$カラバ$$, the $$エゥーゴ$$'s support organization, and fought the $$ティターンズ$$.
After the First $$ネオ・ジオン$$ War, he belonged to $$ロンド・ベル$$, the $$連邦軍$$' independent outside unit. He fought the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces led by $$シャア・アズナブル$$, his former comrade and now bitter enemy.
At the time of the $$一年戦争$$ he was an introverted, naive boy, but through the war he met many people, and through his many experiences grew tremendously as a person.
In the Second $$ネオ・ジオン$$ War, he attempts to stop $$アクシズ$$ from falling to Earth using the $$νガンダム$$, which he himself helped design and develop. Through the supernatural power of the $$サイコ・フレーム$$, he succeeds in pushing $$アクシズ$$ back, but in doing so goes missing along with $$シャア$$, vanishing from history.

83.DSCR:
Supreme commander of $$ネオ・ジオン$$.
His real name is $$キャスバル・レム・ダイクン$$. He is the orphaned son of $$ジオン・ズム・ダイクン$$, who was murdered by the $$ザビ家$$. In the $$一年戦争$$ he won fame as the '$$赤い彗星$$' for his outstanding tactical eye and mobile suit piloting. In the $$グリプス戦役$$ he called himself $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ and fought to overthrow the $$ティターンズ$$, but disappeared after his duel with $$ハマーン$$ during the battle over the $$コロニーレーザー$$.
However, three years after the end of the First $$ネオ・ジオン$$ War, he reappears in the $$地球圏$$ leading a reborn $$ネオ・ジオン$$. The Spacenoids, suffering under the Earth Federation's oppressive rule, welcomed him with overwhelming joy, and many colonies came to cooperate with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.
As the supreme commander of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, he wages war against the Earth Federation through political maneuvering and scheming. But $$ララァ・スン$$ still lives on in his heart even now, and it is because of her that he wishes to settle his score with $$アムロ$$, 14 years in the making.
And then, to drive humanity from the Earth, he carries out the Earth cooling operation. He faces his final battle with $$アムロ$$ on the stage of the falling $$アクシズ$$, and amid the fighting, he is enveloped in the light of the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ and goes missing along with $$アムロ$$.

Free-spirited and prone to intense mood swings, she has a sharp eye for people.
She has an interest in Newtypes, and once trained in India.
Drawn to $$シャア$$, whom she meets in $$ロンデニオン$$, she runs off to $$ネオ・ジオン$$. There she awakens her abilities as a $$ニュータイプ$$, and fights to be of use to $$シャア$$ while piloting a $$ヤクト・ドーガ$$.

In the battle for $$アクシズ$$, she attacks the $$ラー・カイラム$$, but is killed in action by a direct hit from anti-air fire shot by $$チェーン$$, who is aided by the $$サイコ・フレーム$$.

92.DSCR:
An agent sent from the L1 colony cluster as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. 16 years old.
Having grown up undergoing severe combat training from an early age, he possesses outstanding physical ability. His bodily toughness is beyond that of an ordinary person, to the point that he can fall from a 50-story building without dying, or heal his own broken bones.
He also excels not only in combat but in skills such as sabotage and mobile suit repair.
Taciturn and prone to avoiding involvement with others to an extreme degree, he is at heart a kind-hearted boy, and gradually regained his human feelings through his encounters with $$リリーナ$$ and the other $$ガンダム$$ pilots.
Piloting the $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$ and mastering the $$ゼロシステム$$, he trusted in the future he saw there and in his own feelings, and fought against the $$ホワイトファング$$ led by $$ゼクス$$.
In the final battle, he rescues $$リリーナ$$, who had been held captive inside $$リーブラ$$, and settles matters with $$ゼクス$$. He then destroys $$リーブラ$$ as it falls toward Earth, saving the world from a nuclear winter.
During the $$マリーメイア$$ army's rebellion, he was quick to act. He recovered the $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$, which had been jettisoned into the sun, and fought a fierce battle against $$五飛$$, who had become an enemy of the world.
His reckless disregard for his own safety awakened $$リリーナ$$'s courage, becoming the force that brought the fighting to an end.

93.DSCR:
An agent sent from the Sweeper group living near the L2 colony cluster as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. 16 years old.
He pilots the $$ガンダムデスサイズヘル$$.
His personality is one of clearly expressed emotions, and he generally behaves cheerfully. He can sometimes be stubborn, and is the most boyish of the colony-born $$ガンダム$$ pilots. His motto is 'I run and I hide, but I never lie,' and he calls himself the God of Death at every opportunity; by his own account, it is because 'I've never seen a miracle, but I've seen plenty of dead men.'
While infiltrating the lunar base, he meets $$ヒルデ・シュバイカー$$, an $$ＯＺ$$ volunteer soldier, and through their repeated interactions succeeds in opening the eyes of the once-fanatically loyal $$ＯＺ$$ believer. From then on, the two come to cooperate with one another.
In the final battle, he infiltrates $$リーブラ$$ using information from $$ヒルデ$$, freeing the doctors held captive there. He carries them to the $$ピースミリオン$$, successfully altering the course of the falling $$リーブラ$$.
Together with $$ヒイロ$$, he investigates the movements of the $$マリーメイア$$ army, and boards a $$ガンダム$$ once again to fight the enemies of peace.
After the suppression of $$マリーメイア$$'s rebellion, he runs a junk shop on a colony together with $$ヒルデ$$.

94.DSCR:
An agent sent from the L3 colony cluster as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. Estimated age 16.
He pilots the $$ガンダムヘビーアームズ改$$.
He has flown from battlefield to battlefield as a mercenary since childhood, and is a quiet, composed boy whose background remains largely unknown. But he is not a cold-hearted person, and holds a caring warmth for his comrades.
He is especially close with $$カトル$$ among the $$ガンダム$$ pilots, and when $$カトル$$ despaired of the colonies' stance and went berserk, $$トロワ$$ talked him down without regard for his own safety. His own unit was wrecked and he went missing, but he succeeded in restoring $$カトル$$'s sanity in exchange, an act that showed his utter disregard for his own well-being.
He was later found having lost both his memory and his will to fight, and was sheltered at a circus troupe where he was hiding out, posing as $$キャスリン$$'s younger brother. He answers $$カトル$$'s call and returns to the front once more, but promises $$キャスリン$$ that he will come back alive.
The name $$トロワ・バートン$$ is not his real name; the name itself originally belonged to $$ヘビーアームズ$$'s intended pilot, who was killed in a dispute during $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. He happened to witness the killing, and was given this name by $$ドクトルＳ$$ to cover up the murder, living as $$トロワ・バートン$$ ever since.
In $$マリーメイア$$'s rebellion, he infiltrates the $$マリーメイア$$ army to investigate from within. In the battle over Brussels, he puts on a brilliant display of fighting in the $$ヘビーアームズ改$$, delivered to him by $$カトル$$.
After the war ended, he returned to $$キャスリン$$'s circus troupe.

95.DSCR:
The heir of the $$ウィナー家$$, wealthy magnates of the L4 colony cluster. 16 years old.
In $$オペレーション・メテオ$$, he came down to Earth as an agent and served as the pilot of the $$ガンダムサンドロック改$$.
Raised in a wealthy, warm household, he has a gentle, kind personality. At the same time, he combines a battle sense that lets him handle a $$ガンダム$$ expertly with a talent for commanding those around him.
He has 29 older half-sisters, and leads the 40-strong $$マグアナック隊$$. Wherever he goes, he is surrounded by crowds of people, all of whom adore him.
However, when his father, who had steadfastly opposed $$ＯＺ$$, was killed by the colonists, $$カトル$$ went berserk. He assembled the forbidden mobile suit $$ウイングガンダムゼロ$$ and destroyed a colony with it. $$トロワ$$'s desperate persuasion finally brought him back to himself, but only after a great sacrifice had already been paid.
Afterward, he acknowledges his mistake and works tirelessly to atone for it, and even succeeds in bringing the missing $$トロワ$$ back to the battlefield.
He also grew spiritually, coming to hold together the $$ガンダム$$ pilots, who might otherwise have fallen apart.
After the war's end, he proposes scrapping the Gundams, gathers up every $$ガンダム$$ except $$五飛$$'s, loads them onto a resource satellite, and launches them into the sun.
But when the $$マリーメイア$$ army's rebellion breaks out, he sets out to recover the launched Gundams. With only around five seconds of rendezvous time between the recovery ship and the resource satellite, he successfully boards the satellite, delivers the Gundams to the pilots, and becomes a major force in putting down the rebellion.

96.DSCR:
An agent from the L5 colony cluster who came down to Earth as part of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$. 16 years old.
A direct descendant of a warrior clan tracing its origins to ancient China, he was raised as a warrior under the creed that 'strength alone is justice.'
He regards $$ＯＺ$$'s practice of trampling the weak through force as evil, and fights in the belief that it is justice to strike them down with even greater force.
Because of this, when he was defeated by $$トレーズ$$ in unarmed combat, he was forced to confront his own weakness and lost his will to fight. In the midst of this, seeing $$サリィ・ポォ$$ admit her own weakness and still choose to keep fighting, he came to believe that the resolve to keep fighting is what moves the world, and regained his will to fight.
However, though he wins his rematch against $$トレーズ$$ in the final battle, the outcome ends in a puzzling way that could be read as $$トレーズ$$ winning and getting away.
After the war, seeing a world where citizens had forgotten how to fight now that peace had come, while soldiers who had lost their place still remained, he began to question whether justice truly existed in it. As his answer, he deliberately chose to become evil and joined the $$マリーメイア$$ Army.
In the course of the fighting, through dialogue with $$ヒイロ$$ and by witnessing the citizens who rose up to challenge the $$マリーメイア$$ Army, he settled his own doubts and brought his fight to an end.
After that, he accepted $$サリィ・ポォ$$'s invitation and joined the $$プリベンター$$s.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 勝ち逃げ (win and run away) was rendered 'a hollow victory', which is a different meaning; the one who 'wins and gets away' must be Treize since Wufei is stated to win the rematch (inferred, see uncertain)

97.DSCR:
A pilot belonging to the $$プリベンター$$s. Codename Wind. 20 years old.
His real name is $$ミリアルド・ピースクラフト$$. He is the prince of the $$サンクキングダム$$, a nation that once advocated total pacifism and was destroyed by the $$地球圏$$ Unified Alliance.
In the previous war, he declared war on Earth as the leader of $$ホワイトファング$$.
Like $$リリーナ$$, he was a man who carried on his father's will and wished for peace, but when the new $$サンクキングダム$$ that $$リリーナ$$ had restored collapsed, he came to believe that, for the sake of total peace, humanity had to be shown the folly of starting a war, and he attempted to carry out the '$$リーブラ$$ Drop.'
In the final battle, the plan was stopped by the $$ガンダム$$ pilots' efforts, and he himself was defeated after a one-on-one duel with $$ヒイロ$$. He went missing after being caught in the explosion when $$リーブラ$$'s power unit was destroyed, but to counter the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's rebellion, he returned to the battlefield piloting the $$トールギスⅢ$$ under the name '$$プリベンター$$ Wind.'
Because of his past as an $$ＯＺ$$ pilot who fought for revenge for his homeland, he believes his own hands are stained, and he intends to devote his strength to supporting $$リリーナ$$ from behind the scenes for the sake of true peace.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion came to an end, he set off together with $$ノイン$$ to carry out $$リリーナ$$'s terraforming plan.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 完全平和のためには戦争を起こす愚かしさを人類に見せ付けなければならない = 'for total peace, humanity must be shown the folly of starting a war'; the English attached 'for the sake of achieving total peace' to the war itself. Also omission: 新生 (new) Sanc Kingdom

98.DSCR:
A member of the $$プリベンター$$s. Codename Fire.
She was formerly a training instructor for $$ＯＺ$$'s new recruits.
She graduated the military academy in second place, behind only $$ゼクス$$, and excels both as a commanding officer and as a mobile suit pilot.
Since her academy days she has loved $$ゼクス$$ deeply, so much so that she kept an exact count of the time they spent apart.
When she lost the new recruits she had trained to $$五飛$$'s attack, she swore revenge and became $$ゼクス$$'s subordinate, but when $$ゼクス$$ defected from $$ＯＺ$$ she followed him and defected as well, going on to serve as bodyguard to his sister $$リリーナ$$.
When $$リリーナ$$ founded the new $$サンクキングダム$$, $$ノイン$$ served as her aide, handling practical matters such as secretly building up its armed forces.
After the war, she joined the $$プリベンター$$s and worked to maintain the peace, and in the battle against the $$マリーメイア$$ Army in Brussels she piloted a $$トーラス$$, putting on a showing no less impressive than the $$ガンダム$$ pilots'.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion, she was reunited with $$ゼクス$$, and the two of them set off into space together to take part in the terraforming plan.

99.DSCR:
Vice Foreign Minister of the $$地球圏$$ Unified Nation. 16 years old.
She is also the princess of the former $$サンクキングダム$$, which once advocated total pacifism, and her real name is $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$.
She was raised as the daughter of Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$, but after her father's assassination she learned of her true origins and took up her birth father's will to advocate total pacifism, restoring the $$サンクキングダム$$.
Though the nation collapsed under $$ＯＺ$$'s invasion, she was installed as the world's head of state through the machinations of the $$ロームフェラ財団$$. Buffeted by political scheming, she nonetheless continued to consistently appeal to the world for unarmed, nonviolent total pacifism.
With $$トレーズ$$'s rise to power she stepped down as head of state, but her unwavering stance in pursuit of peace earned her the support of many, and she continues to wield immense influence even after the war's end.
Now that the world has moved toward disarmament and her father's ideal has been achieved, she serves as Vice Foreign Minister, working to complete the work of her adoptive father $$ドーリアン$$ by bridging the colonies and Earth.
Because of the scale of her influence, she was abducted by the $$マリーメイア$$ Army, but she faced $$マリーメイア$$ without fear and continued trying to persuade her.
The resolve of $$リリーナ$$ and $$ヒイロ$$ changed the minds of the people who had forgotten about fighting, and that became a great force in ending the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's rebellion.

100.DSCR:
The young girl who symbolizes the $$マリーメイア$$ Army. 7 years old.
She is the daughter born of $$トレーズ$$ and $$レイア・バートン$$, and $$デキム・バートン$$ is her grandfather.
She is proud to be $$トレーズ$$'s daughter and possesses intelligence beyond what one would expect of a 7-year-old girl. However, having been raised as $$デキム$$'s puppet, she has also been indoctrinated with his twisted ideas, and she behaves with arrogance toward others.
In the course of the fighting, moved by $$リリーナ$$'s persuasion and the $$ガンダム$$ pilots' actions, she realized her own mistake, and threw herself in front of $$リリーナ$$ to shield her from $$デキム$$'s bullet.
With the symbolic figurehead $$マリーメイア$$ losing her will to fight, and with the death of $$デキム$$, the army's true leader, the conflict came to an end.
After that, she has been living together with $$レディ・アン$$.

101.DSCR:
Granddaughter of Duke $$デルマイユ$$, representative of the $$ロームフェラ財団$$.
She longs for war and holds her own aesthetic philosophy regarding it.
She is a distant relative of $$トレーズ$$'s (a cousin once removed) and shares a striking resemblance to him in the shape of her eyebrows.
She accompanies $$リリーナ$$ and openly voices her admiration for $$リリーナ$$'s unwavering commitment to total pacifism.
Though indirectly responsible for driving her own grandfather $$デルマイユ$$ to his death, she boards $$リーブラ$$ alone and joins $$ホワイトファング$$, using the $$ゼロシステム$$ to command a $$モビルドール$$ unit and standing in the way of $$ヒイロ$$ and the others.
However, behind her war-loving personality lay a deep hatred of the war that had taken her father from her. In the final battle she confesses her true feelings, revealing that she sought to show the world a devastating war in order to put an end to war itself.
After the decisive battle, she meets $$ノイン$$ while visiting $$トレーズ$$'s grave and tells her she has grown tired of dwelling on the past, showing a determination to look toward the future.
During the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion, she incited citizens who were already simmering with unrest, transporting them to the Presidential residence along with several vehicles.
Her personal car, incidentally, was still painted the same gold as before.

103.DSCR:
Leader of the $$プリベンター$$s. Codename Gold.
A woman of dignity and gentleness alike, skilled in all manner of strategy from military affairs to politics.
Before the war, she served as aide to $$ＯＺ$$'s supreme commander $$トレーズ$$. Devoted to $$トレーズ$$, she was a woman who would stop at nothing and accept no compromise in fulfilling his ideals. Her thoroughness was such that, in her effort to understand $$トレーズ$$'s thinking, she gave rise to a second personality resembling a saint.
Her two personalities remained unstable until she came to understand $$トレーズ$$'s true intentions, at which point they stabilized and merged into the single personality she has today.
During the $$マリーメイア$$ rebellion, she headed to the Presidential residence to save $$マリーメイア$$, the child $$トレーズ$$ left behind.
After the war, she has been living together with $$マリーメイア$$.

104.DSCR:
A member of the $$プリベンター$$s. Codename Water.
She previously served as a military doctor with the Alliance forces. Through her encounters with $$ヒイロ$$ and the others, she grew interested in the $$ガンダム$$ pilots, and after $$ＯＺ$$'s domination of the $$地球圏$$ she became a member of the resistance, supporting them from then on.
A warm and embracing woman, she serves as a kind of buffer between the $$プリベンター$$s and the $$ガンダム$$ pilots.
Her kindness once helped heal the wounded heart of $$五飛$$, who had lost his will to fight after his defeat at $$トレーズ$$'s hands, while she was taking part with a guerrilla unit in her home region, the former China district, and helped him find the will to rise again.
She also has an active side, and during the war she supported and directed various sabotage operations as part of an anti-$$ＯＺ$$ resistance faction, recovering the $$ヘビーアームズ$$ and $$サンドロック$$ and delivering them to their pilots.
After the $$マリーメイア$$ Army's rebellion came to an end, she recruited $$五飛$$ into the $$プリベンター$$s, and continues her activities.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: 故郷の旧中国地区 is the home region of the subject (Sally, whose kindness the sentence describes), not 'his old home region' (Wufei)

105.DSCR:
The star of a traveling circus troupe, skilled at knife throwing.
She is extremely caring by nature, and looks after not only $$トロワ$$ but also $$五飛$$ and $$ヒイロ$$, whom $$トロワ$$ brought along. While doing so, she privately thought that it looked as though the taciturn $$トロワ$$ had made taciturn friends.
Separated from a younger brother by the war, she sees that brother's shadow in $$トロワ$$. For that reason, when $$トロワ$$ tried to blow himself up, she became truly angry and struck him.
After $$トロワ$$ lost his memory, she consistently worried about his well-being, trying among other things to keep him away from battle.
For $$トロワ$$, $$キャスリン$$'s circus troupe was a place to come back to alive, and after $$マリーメイア$$'s rebellion, $$トロワ$$ went back to her.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Catherine is researched female; the old rule made the translator repeat the name in every sentence (5 times); replaced by 'she/her'. Token $$キャスリン$$ kept once in the last paragraph

106.DSCR:
A boy who survives the ravaged world on his own strength, relying on no one else. 15 years old.
A war orphan, but with a bright, positive personality that shows no trace of tragedy. Perhaps because his father was a military engineer, he is skilled at handling machines of every kind. Before boarding the $$フリーデン$$, he lived tenaciously, using his natural initiative and cunning to hunt mobile suits and sell them to junk dealers and the like.
His skill at piloting mobile suits is that of a genius; he immediately mastered the $$ガンダムＸ$$ and $$ガンダムＤＸ$$ on first boarding them. Even in his first battle in outer space, he got the knack in a short time.
During a certain job, he met the $$ニュータイプ$$ girl $$ティファ$$ and fell for her at first sight. From then on, for her sake, he kept showing a single-mindedness that plunged into danger without regard, through fire and water, on the sea or in space, anywhere. That feeling was finally recognized by the $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$, and became a great force in ending the fighting.
After the war, he set out with $$ティファ$$, the two of them together, to go to many places, see many things, and meet many people, so as to think about what kind of future he wants.

107.DSCR:
A naturally awakened $$ニュータイプ$$ girl, born after the Seventh Space War, whose very existence had been whispered to be impossible. 15 years old.
She displays powers that could be called psychic, such as precognition, danger sensing and super-empathy (the Newtypes of '$$ガンダムＸ$$' differ in meaning from those of previous $$ガンダム$$ series).
Targeted by many organizations that wanted to use her ability as research material, she was being held under house arrest somewhere like a $$ニュータイプ$$ research facility when $$ジャミル$$ and the others rescued her. After boarding the $$フリーデン$$, she became the group's guide, and ultimately reached the $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ on the Moon.
Though her $$ニュータイプ$$ ability is something those around her desperately want, she herself fears that power. She also loathed people fighting over it, and so had lived as though half shut off in her heart. But she gradually opened up to $$ガロード$$, who treated her as a girl like any other, and eventually became able to show her feelings outwardly.
In the fighting, she wished to be of help to the people dear to her, starting with $$ガロード$$, and the power heightened by that feeling became the factor that opened the $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ on the Moon.
After the $$フリーデン$$ disbanded, true to her words 'I'll stay with $$ガロード$$,' she set off with $$ガロード$$, who said he wanted to see the world.

108.DSCR:
A pilot of the $$Ｇファルコン$$ who belongs to $$サテリコン$$, a resistance organization against the $$宇宙革命軍$$. 15 years old.
She lost both parents, who were space refugees, soon after birth. Having grown up afterward in an environment of nothing but men, she has rough speech, quickly blurting out 'lame' and the like, and a personality that is about as boyish as can be. Yet tears of sorrow ran down her cheeks when $$サテリコン$$ was annihilated, and tears of joy after the destruction of the $$コロニーレーザー$$ was achieved.
She helped $$ガロード$$ out of a pinch when he went up into space, and that led the two to hit it off and fight together. Later, when she became a member of the $$フリーデン$$, she opened up to $$キッド$$, who was much the same type.
After the fighting ended, she started a junk shop, '$$フリーデンⅢ$$,' with $$キッド$$, $$シンゴ$$ and the others.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Paula is researched female; the old rule made the translator repeat the name 6 times; replaced by she/her. Token $$パーラ$$ removed for that reason

109.DSCR:
A mobile suit pilot hired by the $$フリーデン$$. 17 years old.
He has a manly personality, the type whose hands move before the mouth. His speech is also quite rough.
He was originally a freelance mobile suit pilot, and the $$ガンダムエアマスター$$ is a keepsake of a $$バルチャー$$ who once looked after him. At first he gave the impression of a miser fighting only for money, but it was all done to let the family back home live in comfort.
In the past, his father was killed by a mobile suit pilot, and he agonizes over being unable to tell his mother, who hates such pilots, about his job, yet has the kindness to keep fighting for the family.
Having had many ties with the $$フリーデン$$, he eventually signed an exclusive contract with it.
On the night before the final battle, he handed $$トニヤ$$ a ring and confessed his feelings, and after the war ended took her back to his hometown.

proofread.reason: pronoun: Witz is researched male; the old rule made the translator repeat the name 8 times and write 'the speech', 'the mother', 'the job', 'the hometown' for his own (自分の仕事, 故郷). Token $$ウィッツ$$ removed for that reason

110.DSCR:
A mobile suit pilot hired by the $$フリーデン$$. 18 years old.
True to a freelance mobile suit pilot, he keeps a carefree, easygoing attitude, saying 'I don't like anything ideological.' But he once rushed to the rescue when the $$フリーデン$$, which had hired him before, fell into a crisis, and as he says himself, he is 'surprisingly a good guy.'
Having had many ties with the $$フリーデン$$, he eventually signed an exclusive contract and began traveling with it. On that occasion he built a relaxation room aboard the ship and tried to squeeze membership fees out of the crew. However, because of $$サラ$$'s condition that women get in free, and because money could not be taken from children (under 15), so $$ガロード$$ and $$ティファ$$ were free too, and $$テクス$$ lost a billiards match and so was free as well, it ended up being offered free to nearly everyone who would use it.
Smooth-talking and frivolous, skilled with both hands and mouth, he makes wooing women his hobby. He has lovers in various places, and is diligent enough to visit them whenever he finds time, calling it 'aftercare.' But the woman who had been his true love had already died, and his beloved unit, the $$ガンダムレオパルド$$, is her keepsake.
After the war, though $$サラ$$, for whom he had serious feelings, became $$ジャミル$$'s partner, he displayed his natural playboy ways and had now become close to $$エニル$$.

111.DSCR:
Captain of the $$フリーデン$$, whose purpose is to search for and protect Newtypes. 30 years old.
On top of not showing his emotions, the sunglasses he always wears give an even more taciturn impression. But the crew of the $$フリーデン$$ place immense trust in the captain.
In the $$第７次宇宙戦争$$ he belonged to the Earth Federation Forces, and was a $$ニュータイプ$$ who piloted the $$ガンダムＸ$$. But in the final phase of the great war, he pulled the trigger that led to the greatest tragedy in human history, the '$$コロニー落とし$$.' The guilt became a trauma, and he lost all of his $$ニュータイプ$$ abilities.
He suffered from a cockpit phobia arising from the trauma, but overcame it after meeting $$ガロード$$. From then on, he distinguished himself piloting the $$ガンダムＸディバイダー$$.
By touching the $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ at the end of a long journey, he at last obtained the future he had been searching for. After the war, he became a member of the $$連邦政府$$'s peace council together with $$サラ$$, and chose the path of building with his own hands the world he had dreamed of.

112.DSCR:
A freelance mobile suit pilot whose beloved unit is always a mobile suit painted blue. 19 years old.
Using her skill and beauty, she has survived the postwar world entirely on her own. Having lived a desolate life, chased by nothing but the need to survive, she has a wall that keeps others from her heart.
She got to know $$ガロード$$, who had taken the $$ガンダムエックス$$ out of the $$フリーデン$$, and tried to seduce him, but being rejected wounded her pride, and from then on she kept chasing him in a state of misdirected grudge.
Later she got to know $$トニヤ$$, who was in town on shore leave with half the crew, and deepening a friendship between women brought a change in her feelings. After that she had her life saved by the $$フリーデン$$, and from then on came to work together with $$ガロード$$ as well.
In the epilogue, though how it came about is unclear, she appeared with $$ロアビィ$$ in $$ウィッツ$$'s hometown, and together with $$トニヤ$$ she toyed with the men.

113.DSCR:
Operator of the $$フリーデン$$. 19 years old.
She is in a deputy-captain-like position, and sometimes serves as acting captain when $$ジャミル$$ is absent.
She thinks logically and acts accordingly, but at times could not hold back her emotions and ended up speaking sharply.
She holds feelings for $$ジャミル$$ that go beyond respect, and at times cannot stay calm when it comes to him. There were also scenes where she openly showed jealousy toward $$ティファ$$, who was still a girl. Amid this, $$ロアビィ$$ came on to her and her heart wavered between him and $$ジャミル$$, but in the end she held to her feelings for $$ジャミル$$.
After the war, as a member of the peace council she attended the peace talks with the $$宇宙革命軍$$ together with $$ジャミル$$, and was introduced as a reliable partner.

pilot 62: それを打倒するために (to overthrow that) is written 'to overthrow him' (Kanjelman); the referent of それ is the split of the nation, so it could be read as overthrowing what he did. バランシングの勝負 is 'a balancing contest' (I do not know the Votoms term). The pilot's gender is not settled, so the name is repeated instead of a pronoun.
pilot 62: DSC2 adds two sentences (president then coup; killed by a Strike Dog in the recreated Phantom Club). 'silver wedding anniversary trip event' is literal (銀婚式旅行のイベント).

pilot 63: キリコとの仲を積極的に支援 does not say whose relationship; from the preceding フィアナが合流する頃 I read it as Fyana's bond with Chirico ('フィアナ's bond with キリコ'). ＰＳの能力の高さ is 'the high ability of the PS' (whether Fyana's, Chirico's or PS in general is not stated). Kidera's gender is not settled, so the name is repeated. ＥＸ－１０ (entry 63) and アッセンブルＥＸ－１０ (entries 62, 63) are separate tokens.
pilot 64: 法王 is 'Pope'; the glossary has 法皇テオ８世 = Pope Theo VIII as a separate pilot. I wrote テオ８世 by name because 'the Pope' would be ambiguous after モンテ＝ウェルズ takes the office. 介助者 is 'attendant'.

pilot 68: 混乱時空世紀 is 'Chaotic Space-Time Century' and 特異点 is 'singularity' (both are new tokens; no wiki English). ムウ resolves to the SEED pilot's token in the sheet (a different person; see names). 'Father' for お父様. マイケル and オルソン are the sheet's tokens (Michael, Olson).
pilot 69/70: the Japanese calls Slay 婚約者 (no gender), so 'her betrothed' and no pronoun for Slay. 生殖期 and 生殖可能期間 are both 'reproductive period'. 'wore Emaan clothing' for エマーンの服に袖を通していた.

pilot 71: ジャビー has no gender in the Japanese; written by name and they/them. グローマ is a new token whose type (ship, group or place) I could not determine; it is used as an entity that trades, is saved from trouble and can be returned to. モズク族 is 'Mozuku tribe'. 時空転移 is 'space-time displacement'.
pilot 78: 中佐 is 'Lieutenant Colonel' (other library entries use this rank). 'the pressure' of the Red Comet is quoted (プレッシャー). He is written 'he' because 好漢 (a good man) settles it.

pilot 80: she/her is used because the entry is about a known character and the Jigoku entry (Mineva) says she; the Tengoku Japanese has no pronoun. 旧ジオン公国軍 is 'the former Principality of Zeon military'.
